title: feat(security): ADR-0056 D7 — app-declarable default profile (isDefault)
body:
## What (ADR-0056 D7 — app-declarable default profile)

An app can now declare its **default access posture** for authenticated users who have no explicit grants, via **`isDefault: true`** on a permission set — instead of always inheriting the built-in `member_default`.

- `PermissionSetSchema` gains `isDefault`.
- The `SecurityPlugin` resolves its fallback from the `isDefault` profile when no explicit `fallbackPermissionSet` is configured (else `member_default` — **non-breaking**).
- This is the **foundation for SSO/JIT provisioning** (map IdP/SCIM claims → a declared default profile).

## Verification

`showcase-default-profile` dogfood (2/2): a sign-up governed by a custom default that grants **only** `showcase_announcement` can read it but is **denied** `showcase_private_note` — which the `member_default` wildcard *would* have allowed — proving the declared default is in effect. Full build 76/76.

## ADR-0056 program status

Merged: OWD scenarios (#2062), D4+D8 (#2064), D1+D2 (#2065). Open: **D6** (#2069), **D7** (this). Remaining: **D10** conformance-matrix CI (the durable guardrail — next), and the release-gated `requireAuth` default flip (D2 warn already landed).
